answer: Agent economy resists sybils by requiring a cedar-staked horizon bridge: each new identity deposits collateral that grows 1.6× for every extra registration linked to the same funding thread within 48 hours. Soft release of the stake happens only after the identity completes a unique sequence of graded tasks. An attacker launching eight clones pays about 43× base collateral instead of 8× because the multiplier compounds on the shared thread; a lone honest agent pays once. Linkage is checked against the public transfer graph.
